name: mycel
description: Open-core platform for non-profits: campaign sites, forms, donations, supporters and mailing. Framework-free domain core with HTTP, MCP and web adapters.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/api packages/mcp && npm run typecheck --workspace apps/web
scripts.build: tsc -b packages/api packages/mcp && npm run build --workspace apps/web
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint:deps && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && npm run test:e2e
scripts.db:seed: tsc -b packages/db && npm run -s migrate -w @mycel/db && npm run -s seed -w @mycel/db
